title: Arena map
description: One arena map (M14 k1b, k2a): the walls, hazards and pieces (springs, posts, belts, movers, decor) of the field, the start and goal a race is played on, and the starts and coin zones the Bumper Round uses. The guide is docs/levels.md; the rules a file must keep are in packages/test_game/lib/src/map_rules.dart, run by tools/level.sh check.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, so VS Code autocompletes the fields and marks mistakes as you type. Write "map.schema.json".

format.description: The map format the file is written in (M14 k1b). Today it is 1; a file with a newer format is refused by an older app with a message saying so.

id.description: The map's id, matching its file name (playroom.json has id "playroom") and the entry in index.json. Lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

name.description: The name players see in the map picker: "Playroom".

line.description: One line about the map, for the picker's card: "The first arena: walls, four bumpers and a goal to race for."

notes.description: A comment for the map's author. The app ignores it; the template's instructions are written here.

theme.errorMessage: {value} is not a theme: use playroom, pinball, castle, factory or tops
theme.description: The floor's look, which every map names: the Playroom's mat, or the look of one of M14 k2's four maps (Pinball, Block Castle, Toy Factory, Spinning Tops). A theme only changes how the field is drawn; it never changes the play.

walls.description: The field's walls, at most 24 with the movers together: a wall is a straight segment a marble cannot pass through, and a bouncy one throws it back like a spring.

hazards.description: The hazards, at most 8, none moving faster than one pass every 1.5 s: a marble that touches one is knocked back, or sent to its start if the hazard stands still.

springs.description: The springs, at most 8: a marble that hits one bounces off at 1.5 times its speed, with a bump. A spring is not a hazard: it drops nothing.

posts.description: The posts, solid round blocks a marble bounces off and cannot pass: a tower, a column, a pop bumper's friend.

belts.description: The belts, at most 6: a marble standing on one is carried along it at half its speed, towards the belt's `to` end.

movers.description: The movers, walls that move on a timer, at most 24 with the walls together, one pass taking 1.5 s or more: each swings, spins or slides, and a mover that pins a marble against a wall stops for that step rather than crush it.

decor.description: The scenery drawn round the play (flags, lights, gears) for the theme: it has no collision and no effect on play, and it never hides a marble, a wall or a hazard.

race.description: Where the race starts and the goal pad it races to. Leave it out for a map only the Bumper Round plays; a map needs at least one of race and bumper.

bumper.description: The Bumper Round's four start spots and the zones its coins appear in. Leave it out for a race-only map; a map needs at least one of race and bumper.

fraction.description: A fraction of the field: 0..1 across (x) or 0..1 down (y), so 0.5 is the middle and 1 the far edge.

point.description: A spot on the field: [x, y] in fractions of the field.

rect.description: A rectangle on the field: [left, top, right, bottom] in fractions of the field.

wall.description: One wall: a segment from one spot to another, drawn thick enough to bounce a marble off, 24 at most.

from.description: Where the wall starts, in fractions of the field.

to.description: Where it ends: a zero-length wall is refused.

bouncy.description: Whether the wall kicks like a spring (true), throwing a marble back at 1.5 times its speed, as a pinball table's slingshots do. The default false.

hazard.description: One hazard: a slide (a bar sweeping between two spots) or an orbit (a bar circling a centre), with how long one pass takes, or a still one (a drain) that never moves.

oneOf.description: A slide: a bar sweeping from one spot to another and back.

from.description: One end of the sweep, in fractions of the field.

oneOf.description: An orbit: a bar circling a centre, its radius a fraction of the field's shorter side.

orbit.description: The circle the bar sweeps around.

centre.description: The circle's centre, in fractions of the field.

radius.description: The distance from the centre to the bar, as a fraction of the field's shorter side.

oneOf.description: A still hazard: a drain that never moves, so a marble that touches it is sent back to its start at once, with no kick to recover from.

at.description: The spot it fills, in fractions of the field.

periodS.description: Seconds one pass takes: the time from where the hazard starts back to it. At least 1.5, or the hazard is too fast to dodge.

moverPeriodS.description: Seconds one pass takes: the time from where the mover starts back to it. At least 1.5, or the mover is too fast to dodge.

size.description: A size as a fraction of the field's shorter side, so it means the same across and down.

degrees.description: An angle in degrees, clockwise from across the field: 0 points right, 90 down.

spring.description: One spring: a green cap over a yellow coil, which throws a marble back at 1.5 times its speed. Never red, since red means a hazard.

at.description: The spring's middle, in fractions of the field.

radius.description: How wide it is; 0.05 when the file says none.

post.description: One post: a solid round block a marble bounces off. It is not a spring and not a hazard.

at.description: The post's middle, in fractions of the field.

radius.description: How wide it is; 0.055 when the file says none.

belt.description: One belt: a strip a marble standing on is carried along at half its speed, towards the `to` end.

from.description: Where the belt starts, in fractions of the field.

to.description: Where it ends, the way it carries; a zero-length belt is refused.

width.description: How wide the strip is; 0.09 when the file says none.

mover.description: One mover: a wall that moves, swinging about a pivot, spinning about one, or sliding between two places.

oneOf.description: A swing: a bar turning about a pivot between two angles, like a flipper.

swing.description: The bar and the two angles it turns between.

pivot.description: The point it turns about, in fractions of the field.

length.description: How long the bar is, out from the pivot.

oneOf.description: A spin: a bar turning about a pivot at one steady speed, all the way round, like a carousel.

spin.description: The bar and the pivot it turns about.

pivot.description: The point it turns about, in fractions of the field.

length.description: How long the bar is; it is centred on the pivot.

oneOf.description: A slide: a bar travelling between two places, like a gate or a press.

slide.description: The two places it travels between, and the angle the bar lies at.

from.description: One place the bar's middle reaches, in fractions of the field.

length.description: How long the bar is; it is centred on its middle.

deg.description: The angle the bar lies at.

decor.description: One piece of scenery: a flag, a light or a gear, drawn only.

kind.errorMessage: {value} is not a decor kind: use flag, light, gear
kind.description: Which piece of scenery it is: a pennant, a lamp or a cog.

at.description: Where it stands, in fractions of the field.

size.description: How big it is drawn; 0.09 when the file says none.

phase.description: How far through its pass the hazard starts, 0..1 (the default 0), so two hazards on one period can set off apart.

race.description: Where the race sets off and the pad it races to.

start.description: Where the first player starts, in fractions of the field; the other three start above and below it.

goal.description: The goal pad: a marble that is wholly inside it, and safe from hazards there, has finished.

swapSides.description: Whether each round flips the field left to right, so the start and the goal swap sides (the default true, as the race does today).

bumper.description: The Bumper Round's parts of the map.

starts.description: The four spots its marbles start on, in fractions of the field: 3 marble diameters apart or more, clear of walls and of every hazard's sweep.

coins.description: The zones a coin may appear in, one or more rects in fractions of the field: each clear of walls and big enough for three coins side by side.
